events.text: Square given the name Gutenbergplatz after Johannes Gutenberg.

events.text: Square renamed Auguste-Viktoria-Platz after the German Empress.

evidence.quote: in 1892 it was renamed Auguste-Viktoria-Platz in honour of the German Empress Augusta Viktoria of Schleswig-Holstein

evidence.quote: It was consecrated in 1895

evidence.quote: the 1899 building on the site of todays Europa-Center

evidence.quote: which after 1916 housed the Romanisches Café
